name: Servo
description:
Servo is an open-source, independent web browser engine written in Rust. Designed for high concurrency, memory safety, and performance, Servo pioneers a parallel architecture for layout, styling, and rendering.

Features:
- Parallelized layout and CSS style computation utilizing multi-core processors
- Memory-safe architecture written in Rust to minimize memory vulnerability exploits
- Embeddable web view engine designed for desktop applications and embedded systems
- WebGL and WebGPU hardware-accelerated graphics rendering
- Active community development driving independent web engine standards
